apks.help: Download the Quest APK (Sclerosis_v...apk, about 964 MB) from CreaTeam's itch.io page. The .zip on the same page is the Windows build.

inputs.label: Amnesia: The Dark Descent
inputs.help: Your installed copy of Amnesia: The Dark Descent from Steam or another store. QGPUI copies its files to the headset.

steps.text: Open Sclerosis from Library > Unknown Sources.

notes: Uncertain. The guide only says to copy "the files of the original game" to the root of /sdcard/; it does not say whether that means the folder contents or the folder, nor which files. This recipe pushes every file of the install to /sdcard/. Check against the game before marking reviewed. detect uses Amnesia.exe, which the guide names only for the PC build (Amnesia.exe or AmnesiaGW.exe); other stores may have only one. Steam app ID 57300 comes from the guide's store link. Free space: the APK alone is about 964 MB plus the game files; no total is given.
